name: WittyTuner
summary: Live TV and recording: network tuners, IPTV playlists, capture cards and guide data. Encrypted channels are refused.
needs: FFmpeg, which comes with the server
A tuner or an IPTV playlist
updates: All of it: every kind of tuner, finding them, reading their channels, scanning and checking them, the guide sources, opening a stream, and Settings, Live TV & tuners and the first-run step on every app.
stays: The guide, recordings, favourites and sets stay with the server, and so does refusing encrypted channels, on purpose: the server watches every stream itself. Your tuners, channels and guide sources are WittyTuner's own, in its data folder.
